verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim natural-language operation via the Supermemory MCP: "Ask naturally. The assistant selects the right Supermemory tool without requiring code or tool names," and a live probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is real and OAuth-gated as documented. This lets AI-native users interact via natural language through any MCP-compatible assistant rather than raw API calls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the natural-language flow actually working end-to-end (beyond vendor docs and endpoint liveness), and no community corroboration of NL command quality.
